storyteller.deleteSavedMessage: The saved story will be deleted permanently.
storyteller.toggleRemoteTooltip: Toggle between local and remote player
storyteller.storyTitlePlaceholder: e.g. The Voyage to the Unknown Planet
storyteller.prologueHint: You take the first step! Write the opening sentence or prologue for your collaborative story.
storyteller.roomNeedTwo: At least 2 players are needed in the lobby.
storyteller.liveDesc: Everyone writes in turn the same evening: invite players to the lobby, the host starts.
storyteller.overDaysDesc: Play over days: add the players below and send each one their own link.
storyteller.waitingSubtitle: This player is marked as remote. As soon as their turn is submitted, the story will continue automatically.
storyteller.modBlindDesc: Players only see the last 10 words of the previous player's contribution, not the entire story.
storyteller.modTimeDesc: A countdown runs down each turn. When time expires, text is submitted automatically.
storyteller.modRouletteDesc: The system picks 3 random required words per turn that must appear in the text before submitting.
storyteller.shareLinksDesc: Players can join using QR code or link on their own device and receive push notifications when it is their turn.
storyteller.scanQrToPlayAs: Scan this code to play as {{name}}!
storyteller.spectatorNotTurn: It is not {{name}}'s turn right now.
